answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A lantern ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A cedar expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A lagoon renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 6278 identities cost 966 paid peers, 12017 tokens of stake and 10369 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
